<!--
  A consent notice: an icon, a heading, one paragraph and the buttons accept, decline and (optionally) settings.
  Axes: layout (bar, card), actions (two, three), tone (default, muted).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

  export type CookieBannerProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    text: string;
    accept: string;
    decline: string;
    settings?: string;
    layout?: "bar" | "card";
    actions?: "two" | "three";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    text,
    accept,
    decline,
    settings,
    layout = "bar",
    actions = "two",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: CookieBannerProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : tpl("{0}-title", id))}
  data-testid="cookie"
  data-layout={layout}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Container class={cn("mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4", "py-4")} data-slot="container">
    <Box
      class={cn(
        "flex flex-col gap-4 rounded p-6 inset-ring inset-ring-border",
        (((tone as string) === "muted") ? "bg-muted" : "bg-card"),
        (
          (layout as string) === "bar" ? "md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between"
          : "mx-auto w-full max-w-md"
        )
      )}
    >
      <Group gap="4" align="start" class="min-w-0">
        <LucideIcon name="cookie" size={24} />
        <Stack gap="2">
          <Title as={2} size="base" weight="bold" id={tpl("{0}-title", id)}>
            {title}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {text}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Group>
      <Group gap="2" class="shrink-0 flex-wrap">
        {#if (((actions as string) === "three") && settings)}
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="cookie-settings">
            {settings}
          </Button>
        {/if}
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="cookie-decline">
          {decline}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="default" size="sm" type="button" data-testid="cookie-accept">
          {accept}
        </Button>
      </Group>
    </Box>
  </Container>
</Block>
